one_line: A learned monk-scholar of Vallabhi’s bustling 7th‑century urban academies, bridging Buddhist philosophy with law, administration and mercantile accountancy.

appearance.face: oval face with medium-brown Saurashtrian complexion, straight nose, sharp but kind eyes with slightly arched brows, a neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, default expression calm, attentive and mildly determined
appearance.hair: thick black hair combed back from the forehead and tied into a modest topknot at the crown, with a narrow white cotton headband circling the head and knotted discreetly at the back
appearance.costume: simple monk-scholar attire: an inner long-sleeved knee-length white cotton tunic (kurta-style) with a modest round neck, paired with straight loose ankle-length light ochre cotton trousers; over this, a saffron-ochre Buddhist-style uttariya robe draped from the left shoulder across the chest and around the back, leaving the right arm fully covered by the tunic, the robe’s edges finely bordered with a narrow maroon stripe; around his waist a plain dark brown woven cotton belt; on his feet soft brown leather sandals with simple straps; a small, well-used palm-leaf manuscript bundle bound with a red cord tucked at his left hip, and a plain wooden abacus-like counting board peeking from a cloth satchel slung diagonally across his back, indicating his training in accountancy and administration.
appearance.signature: a compact rectangular wooden writing tray held in his left hand, containing a rolled palm-leaf manuscript, an iron stylus and a small clay ink-pot, symbolizing Vallabhi’s multi-disciplinary scholarship and practical record-keeping.

ref_desc: A lean medium-brown monk-scholar in white tunic and ochre trousers, saffron-ochre robe with maroon border, black hair in a topknot with white headband, brown sandals, carrying a wooden writing tray with palm-leaf manuscript and stylus, in saffron, white, maroon, brown and black.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style male scholar from 7th-century Vallabhi: early 30s, lean, medium-brown complexion, oval face, calm determined eyes, short beard and moustache, thick black hair tied in a topknot with a narrow white headband. He wears a long-sleeved knee-length white cotton tunic over loose ankle-length light ochre trousers, belted with a plain dark brown woven belt. Draped over his left shoulder and around his torso is a saffron-ochre Buddhist-style robe with a fine maroon border, covering the chest and back while the tunic sleeves cover both arms. On his feet are simple brown leather sandals. At his left hip sits a small bundled palm-leaf manuscript tied with a red cord, and an abacus-like wooden counting board partly visible from a cloth satchel slung across his back. In his left hand he holds a compact rectangular wooden writing tray containing a rolled palm-leaf manuscript, an iron stylus and a tiny clay ink-pot, presented clearly as his signature prop. Use a palette dominated by saffron-ochre, white, maroon, dark brown and black, and show him standing neutrally so all costume details and the writing tray are clearly visible from head to toe.
